are transmitted, the timer according to
• either TCPIP_PARAMID_TCP_RETRANSMIT_TIMEOUT if provided by TcpIp_-
ChangeParameter() or
• TcpIpTcpRetransmissionTimeout if TCPIP_PARAMID_TCP_RETRANSMIT_TIMEOUT
was not provided by TcpIp_ChangeParameter()
shall be restarted the last time before the TCP connection is closed.⌋()
